nodes.author: Yadofied
nodes.text: Dumdums who are crowing the loudest, don't even know what a "novel strain" means. Nor do they know it's the pediatric age group most at risk or global prevalence of hmpv. Makes me think if it's just a concerted effort at sinophobic propaganda. https://t.co/Z0NRXXsXUf

nodes.author: lancelot_pinto
nodes.text: HMPV isn’t new. What we don’t know is whether the strain is novel, and has a virulence that’s different from what we’ve experienced in the past. Hopefully, whole genome sequencing and clinical information will clarify soon. 2/2
